category_override_reason: Cluster was labeled AUDIO_FAIL (a runner bucket, not a real triage category). The decisive per-turn failure across all three evals is a single tool-parameter EXACT_MATCH mismatch on verify_passcode (parameter_correctness_score: 0). That is an EXPECTATION_FAIL on tool-invocation parameter correctness, NOT a TEXT_MISMATCH, TOOL_MISSING, or TIMEOUT. Surface symptom to verify the fix against is the verify_passcode passcode parameter.
root_cause: ASR casing variance, not an agent bug. On the AUDIO channel (gemini-3.1-flash-live) the spoken passcode 'Sunset' is transcribed lowercase ('sunset'), so the model calls verify_passcode(passcode='sunset'). All three goldens assert passcode: "Sunset" as a plain string, which the platform matches with EXACT_MATCH and a tool_invocation_parameter_correctness_threshold of 1, yielding 'String mismatch: Sunset != sunset' -> parameter_correctness_score 0 -> overall_tool_invocation_result FAIL (score 0.5) on that turn -> golden FAIL. The agent itself behaves correctly: the verify_passcode tool compares case-insensitively (python_code.py line 93: passcode.strip().lower() == record['passcode'].lower()), returns verified:true, the alarm cancels, dispatch ('police were not dispatched') is reported accurately, and end_session fires. Every other dimension passes: semantic_similarity = 4 ('Fully Consistent') on all agent turns, all custom evaluation_expectation_results PASS (including 'must call verify_passcode with the spoken passcode' and 'must report police were not dispatched'), and every other tool (lookup_accounts_by_caller, cancel_alarm, end_session) PASSes. The three SHORT goldens (passcode_gate, fort_worth, single_site) pass 3/3 in audio precisely because they never reach a verify_passcode turn with an exact-match string arg. The same goldens pass 3/3 on TEXT because typed 'Sunset' preserves casing. Note the run's thresholds even show semantic_similarity_channel: TEXT while running audio, but that is not what is failing here -- semantic scores all PASS; the failure is purely the exact-match string arg.

fix_summary_one_line: Make the verify_passcode passcode arg ASR-casing-tolerant in all three goldens: replace plain string passcode: "Sunset" with a case-insensitive match (e.g. $matchType: "regexp", $matchValue: "(?i)^Sunset$") so the AUDIO-channel transcription 'sunset' matches; do the same for the "Bluebird" UC2 goldens to harden them before they hit audio.
fix_detail:
In goldens.yaml change the three verify_passcode passcode args (uc1 lines 47-49, dispatch lines 209-211, closing lines 283-285) from `passcode: "Sunset"` to a $matchType dict, e.g.:
          - action: verify_passcode
            args:
              passcode:
                $matchType: "regexp"
                $matchValue: "(?i)^Sunset$"
                $originalValue: "Sunset"
Alternatives: $matchType: "semantic" or $matchType: "ignore" (the custom expectation 'must call verify_passcode with the spoken passcode' already independently guards this and PASSes, so ignore is safe). regexp with (?i) is preferred because it still pins the passcode value while tolerating ASR casing -- this is the audio analogue of the existing rule #5 ($matchType ignore for dates). NOT a threshold change: tool_invocation_parameter_correctness_threshold should stay at 1; the right knob is the per-arg match type, not the global threshold.
